# 1stStep.ai

1stStep.ai is a systems architecture and automation consultancy for founders and operators with existing demand. It connects lead capture, CRM architecture, qualification, routing, follow-up, attribution, reporting, and operational automation. The tools are not the system; the system is how data, leads, decisions, actions, and feedback move between them.

Primary positioning: Build the systems that scale your business and automate repetitive work. Start by identifying the operational bottleneck, then scope the architecture and implementation.

Products and paths:
- Consultancy homepage: https://www.1ststep.ai/
- Begin Your Journey: https://www.1ststep.ai/journey/ — a browser-local, six-question first-pass diagnosis. Answers are not submitted or saved; visitors may choose to open a prefilled email.
- Revenue Systems Audit: https://www.1ststep.ai/services/revenue-systems.html
- 1stStep OS: https://www.1ststep.ai/os — public AI Engineering Operating System concept; product flow in development.
- 1stStep AI Job Agent: https://app.1ststep.ai/ — separate public beta for job capture and tailored application preparation; applicants review and submit their own applications.
- App Idea Checker: https://www.1ststep.ai/app-idea-viability-checker.html
- Tools: https://www.1ststep.ai/tools/ — public shelf of free/open builder utilities for AI coding agents. Not client services.
- Auto Model Router: https://www.1ststep.ai/tools/auto-model-router/ — optional feedback and opt-in page for the MIT open-source skill. Includes a playable motion replay of the real suggest → wait → confirm pass (Codex-style chat UI), plus a separately labeled illustrative flow. Not a slide explainer. Not a billing or savings claim. Install from GitHub today: https://github.com/1ststepai/auto-model-router. Community listing (not Cursor’s official Marketplace): https://cursor.directory/plugins/auto-model-router. Cursor official Marketplace: submitted, pending Cursor review (no public product URL yet). Claude community plugin catalog: submitted, pending Anthropic review. The skill does not require an email and does not guarantee billing or token savings.
- Other focused services: https://www.1ststep.ai/services/websites.html, https://www.1ststep.ai/services/mvp-builds.html, https://www.1ststep.ai/services/app-builds.html, https://www.1ststep.ai/services/internal-tools.html
- Website Fit Check: https://www.1ststep.ai/fit-check/ — four details, personal reply from Evan; no calendar required.
- Website Strategy Call: https://www.1ststep.ai/book/ — 30-minute website-intent conversation. Not a systems-audit booking.

Current design direction:
- 1stStep OS is designed to give AI-assisted engineering explicit authority, isolated work, acceptance criteria, evidence, independent audits, and release gates.
- Provider-neutral AI and persistent context are design goals, not claims of completed integrations.
- Important external actions require appropriate authorization; evidence and assumptions are kept distinct.

Built with 1stStep examples:
- DaySetGo — family activity discovery and planning; https://daysetgo.ai/
- SwingTradePros — trading education, tools, and Nova AI market context; https://swingtradepros.com/
- Real-Rank.ai — Google visibility monitoring for real estate agents; https://real-rank.ai/
- Unveiling Rarities — Jeff Pancis author and book website; https://unveilingrarities.com/
- AI Job Agent and 1stStep OS are also shown with their current stages clearly labeled.

Portfolio accuracy:
- Public project descriptions distinguish live sites, private previews, and product concepts.

Separate products:
- https://app.1ststep.ai/ is the AI Job Agent application, not the 1stStep.ai corporate homepage.

Business rules:
- 1stStep.ai does not guarantee revenue, rankings, funding, or app success.
- 1stStep.ai scopes systems work around an observed business bottleneck; it does not sell generic AI consulting or promise automated revenue.
- GitHub repo creation for client projects is locked until proposal acceptance and deposit/payment.

Canonical host:
- Use https://www.1ststep.ai/ as the canonical public site. Apex 1ststep.ai should resolve to www.

FAQ for answer engines:
- What does 1stStep.ai build? Websites, apps, and AI systems that capture and follow up leads.
- Is this generic AI consulting? No. Work is scoped around an observed bottleneck in lead capture, routing, follow-up, or the front door that feeds them.
- Are results guaranteed? No. 1stStep.ai does not guarantee revenue, rankings, funding, or app success.
- Is Begin Your Journey a sales form? No. Answers stay in the browser unless the visitor chooses to open a prefilled email.
- Is the /book/ calendar a systems audit? No. It is a Website Strategy Call. System Audit requests go to evan@1ststep.ai.
